name: Kim R. Walberg
tagline: Top rated Business Litigation attorney in Chicago, Illinois
education: Loyola University Chicago School of Law
about: Kim R. Walberg is an attorney providing legal services covering Business Litigation, Gaming, Constitutional Law, Employment Litigation: Defense, Estate & Trust Litigation and Intellectual Property Litigation.

Kim Walberg, who practices law in Chicago, Illinois, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2019 - 2027. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.
Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at Loyola University Chicago School of Law. She graduated in 1999. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1999.
